AuthorLevel.description: An author's log line's level, as TTI's `LG` writes it.

oneOf.description: An error.
A warning.
Information.

author_log_bytes.description: The longest author's log line, in bytes of UTF-8.

log_characters.description: The longest operator's log line, in characters.

named_connections.description: The connections one message may name.

reply_limit_ms.description:
How long the server waits for an answer to `connected` or
`selected`, in milliseconds (REQ-1481).

title_characters.description: The longest title, magazine name or section, in characters.

CharacterSet.description: The page's default character set (EN 300 706 clause 15, table 32).

national_option.description: The national option, C12 to C14 of the header, 0 to 7.

region.description:
The region, bits 3 to 6 of the default set's designation, carried
in packet X/28/0; none for no packet X/28/0.

Connections.description:
Who a message is for: every open connection of the channel, or the
connections named. A connection named that has closed is passed over
(REQ-1473).

Control.description:
The control bits C4 to C11 of a page header (EN 300 706 clause
9.3.1.3). The server sets C4 and C11 itself on every page it sends, so
that each replaces the last and stands alone (`SERVER.md` section 5.2).

CookiePair.description: A cookie as a request carries it.

block.description: A block cursor rather than an underline.

oneOf.description: Every open connection.

HoverAction.description: The pointer came onto a control or went off it.

oneOf.description: Came onto it.
Went off it.

page.description: Its number, in its magazine, never a reserved one.

section.description: The heading a receiver shows it under, or none.

subpages.description: How many sub-pages it has, 1 to 8,190.

title.description: Its title, shown in a receiver's lists and overview.

oneOf.description: A key pressed, repeating or released: every one is sent.

base.description:
The United States layout's character of the same key, when it
differs from `key`.

text.description: The text the key produced, if any.

oneOf.description:
A mouse button pressed or released, or the pointer moved, over the
page.

button.description:
The button pressed or released, 0 left, 1 middle, 2 right; none
for a move.

buttons.description: The buttons held during a move; none for a press or release.

oneOf.description:
The wheel turned over a cell, in 1/120ths of a line, positive right
and down.
The pointer came onto one of the page's controls, or went off it.
Text that came from no key: an input method's, or a phone's.
A paste: data, never keystrokes.
The keys came to the page.
The keys left it: let go of anything held.
Pressed.
Repeating while held.
Released.

label.description:
The prompt: at most 9 characters for this service, 8 for another;
none for the Index key.

target.description:
Where it leads: `mpp`, `mpp:ssss`, `name:mpp`, `name:mpp:ssss`, an
`http` or `https` address, or `web:` and one (Appendix E.1).

KeyName.description: A W3C KeyboardEvent.key name, from the engine's table (INPUT.md section 5.6), or the one character of a character key.

Link.description: A link: a page and a sub-code.

LinkExtension.description:
A sub-page's Link Extension links (the engine's Appendix E; REQ-1478
version 3, REQ-1494).

keys.description: The keys' links, as TTI's `LN` lines: each key at most once.

numbers.description: Page numbers on the page that lead elsewhere, as TTI's `LK` lines.

texts.description: Runs of text on the page that lead elsewhere, as TTI's `LT` lines.

LinkKey.description: A key of the Link Extension.

name.description: Its name, which a receiver shows.

pages.description: Its pages, in ascending order: at most 253, 251 in magazine 1.

MessageType.description: The types of message a program sends.

oneOf.description: A button pressed.
A button released.
The pointer moved.

NumberLink.description: A page number on the page that leads elsewhere (`LK`).

number.description: The page number as the page shows it.

target.description: Where it leads, in a form of Appendix E.1, never `web:`.

PackedLine.description: A packed line other than X/26, by its packet.

oneOf.description: X/27 of designation code 1 to 3: thirty-nine values of four bits.
X/27 of designation code 4 to 15: thirteen triplets.
X/28: thirteen triplets.
M/29, the magazine's: thirteen triplets.

Page.description:
One sub-page of a page, as the engine's page model (`PageFile`), field
by field (REQ-1478). A sub-page travels alone, never with the others of
its page (DEC-1500, REQ-1501): a page of one sub-page is a page whose
list has one entry.

control.description: The control bits C4 to C11 (clause 9.3.1.3).

cursor.description: The input cursor (INPUT.md section 7.1), or none.

display_row_24.description: Packet X/27/0's link control: row 24 is displayed.

enhancements.description: Packets X/26, at most one of each designation code.

link_extension.description:
The TTI Link Extension's links that packets cannot carry (the
engine's Appendix E; REQ-1494), sent as the sub-page's LINKS record.

links.description:
The six links of packet X/27/0 (EN 300 706 clause 9.6.1): red,
green, yellow, cyan, the fifth and the index; none for a null link.

packets.description: Packets X/27 of designation codes 1 to 15, X/28 and M/29.

page.description: The page's number, never a reserved one.

rows.description:
Rows 0 to 24, each 40 character codes of seven bits as exact
base64 of 40 bytes; none for a blank row. Row 0's columns 0 to 7
are the receiver's (EN 300 706 clause 9.3.1.4).

PageNumber.description: A page number: three hexadecimal digits in capitals, the magazine 1 to 8 first (EN 300 706 clause 7.1.2).

ProgramMessage.description: A message from a program to the server.

oneOf.description: The answer to `connected` (REQ-1471).

magazines.description: The channel's magazines for this viewer (REQ-1477).

selected.description:
The sub-page the connection's selection shows: the one it selected;
for a page selected with 3F7F, the page's first sub-page in
ascending sub-code order (0000 when the page has it); for none, the
initial page's first. None when the program has nothing to show.

oneOf.description: One sub-page, to the connections named (REQ-1472, REQ-1473).
A page's sub-page list (REQ-1503).

subpages.description: The sub-pages in the page's order, each sub-code at most once.

version.description:
The list's version, which the program changes whenever the list
changes.

oneOf.description: A change to the magazines and their pages.

magazines.description: The magazines, as a reply gives them.

oneOf.description: Sends a connection to a page.

address.description:
Another channel's address, at most the engine's
[`MAX_ADDRESS`](neoteletext_web::records::redirect::MAX_ADDRESS) bytes:
the most a REDIRECT record carries.

sub.description: The sub-code, or 3F7F for the page.

oneOf.description: A sound, its data, or a command.
A stored Opus sound (decision 21).

packets.description: Its packets back to back, exact base64, at most two minutes.

samples.description: Its length in samples at 48 kHz.

oneOf.description: A live Opus sound's object.
A live Opus sound's next packets.

A stored sound as 16-bit samples, which the server encodes as IMA
ADPCM, for receivers that decode no Opus.

pcm.description:
16-bit little-endian mono samples, exact base64, at most two
minutes.

rate.description: Its sample rate, one of the profile's.

oneOf.description: A live sound's object.
A live sound's next blocks of samples.
Play a sound on an audio channel.

after.description: It plays after the sound playing ends.

duck.description: How far other channels duck under it, 0 to 6.

page.description: The page it belongs to, or none for the whole service.

oneOf.description: Stop an audio channel.
Change an audio channel's gain.
Sets or clears one of the program's cookies for a connection.

max_age.description:
`Max-Age` in seconds, 0 removing it, or none for a cookie that
lasts the browser's session.

name.description: Its name; names starting `_` are the server's.

oneOf.description:
A line for the developer console of the viewer's browser (the
engine's REQ-INP-026).

page.description: The page it concerns, or none.

text.description:
Its text: UTF-8 of 1 to 200 bytes, no control or bidirectional
formatting character (the engine's `log::check`).

oneOf.description: A line for the server operator's log.

event.description:
The kind of event, a name that does not change: lower case
letters, digits and `_`.

oneOf.description: Raw teletext packets (`SERVER.md` section 7.4).

packets.description: Whole 42-byte packets back to back, exact base64.

Rule.description: Why a message was refused: a closed list (REQ-1475).

The line is longer than `budgets.line_bytes`.
A field the message's type does not have.
A field the message's type needs is missing.
A field is given twice.
A value of the wrong JSON type, or not in its format.
A value outside its closed list, a message's `type` among them.
A number outside its range.
Text or a list longer than its bound.
Text or a list shorter than its bound, or empty.
A list not in ascending order.
The same number or code twice.
A page number the standard reserves.
A page listed under another magazine.

A character text may not have: a control or a bidirectional
formatting character.
Text not in Unicode normalisation form C.
Not exact base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, padded, no whitespace).
Bytes of the wrong length once decoded.
A selected page not in the index.
A connection that is not open.
An answer to nothing the server asked: a second `reply`.
A sound outside the profile the receivers decode.
A raw packet the stream may not carry (REQ-1462).

sub.description: The sub-code, or 3F7F for the page and none of its sub-pages.

ServerMessage.description: A message from the server to a program.

oneOf.description: The program is to serve its channel: sent once, when it starts.

epoch_ms.description: The time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

standard.description: The standard's maxima, from the engine's `neoteletext_core::limits`.

oneOf.description: A viewer's connection opened (REQ-1471); answer with `reply`.

connection.description: The connection: the program addresses it by this while it is open.

cookies.description: The cookies the program set on earlier connections.

path.description: `selection`'s place, as an address names it: `302` or `302/0002`.

query.description:
The query of the address, without its `?`, or none (DEC-1730). It goes
with the selection (see [`Selected`]).

selection.description:
What the connection selected at its start, or none: the channel's
initial page. A connection is one browser tab with one selection
(DEC-1527).

session.description: The viewer's session, from its signed cookie (requirement 5.5).

oneOf.description:
A connection selected a page or a sub-page (REQ-1472); answer with
`page`.

path.description: The place selected, as an address names it: `302` or `302/0002`.

query.description:
The query of the address selected, without its `?`, exactly as
written, or none (DEC-1730). It belongs to this one selection: the
next one that has none says so here. The server does not interpret
it: it is untrusted text from the viewer.

sub.description: The sub-code, or 3F7F for the page and none of its sub-pages.

oneOf.description: Input on a page (INPUT.md).

lost.description:
A release the page lost: the key or button did not come up, the page
lost the input or the connection went (REQ-207). A game can tell
"the player let go" from "the player left".

page.description:
The page on screen when it happened: the event's stamp, which is the
connection's selection, or for a release the page that held it
(REQ-1557). Focus and raw text carry no stamp, and are for the
selection as it stands.

sub.description: The sub-code on screen when it happened.

oneOf.description: A connection's selection left a page, or the connection closed.
A session ended, five minutes after its last connection closed.
The server's and the channel's figures, every ten seconds.
A message the program sent was refused (REQ-1475).

message.description:
The type of the message refused, or none when it had none the
protocol knows.

path.description:
The path to the first fault, such as `magazines[2].pages[14].title`;
empty for the message as a whole.

decimal_subpages.description: Sub-codes a viewer can key, 0001 to 3979.

keyable_pages.description: Those a viewer can key, 100 to 899.

pages.description:
Page numbers that may carry a page: 00 to FF in each magazine, less
those the standard reserves (Annex A.10).

pages_in_magazine_1.description: Pages magazine 1 may have, 1BE and 1F0 reserved too: 251.

subpages.description: Sub-pages a page may hold, 0001 to 3F7E.

SubCode.description: A sub-code: four hexadecimal digits in capitals, 0000 to 3F7F, no bit outside the thirteen (EN 300 706 clause 9.3.1.2); 3F7F means any sub-page.

SubPageEntry.description: One entry of a page's sub-page list.

title.description: Its title, at most a row's 40 characters, or none.

TextLink.description: A run of text on the page that leads elsewhere (`LT`).

length.description: Its characters, keeping the run within the row's 40 columns.

target.description: Where it leads, in a form of Appendix E.1.

Triplet.description: A triplet, by its fields (EN 300 706 clause 12.3.1).
